ledger.claim: The rider was at the registered pickup point 'Blk 41 Sims Dr (shelter pickup)' for the whole waiting window and was never absent. His own device track carries 42 fixes, every one of them inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for a STANDARD zone, spanning 17:34:40 to 17:40:49, with a maximum distance of 11.74 m and a mean of 6.49 m from the pin, and a single recorded speed of 0.0 km/h. This is a rider who stood exactly where he was told to wait, in the rain, from before the driver tapped 'arrived' until the driver cancelled.

At 17:35:40 the rider sent the only locating message in the log: 'please drive to the shelter, it's pouring'. The shelter is precisely the sub-location this trip records for pickup - 'Blk 41 Sims Dr (shelter pickup)' - so the rider named the correct pickup point, and identified which face of the location he was on, five minutes before the driver cancelled. That is the locating and coordinating conduct POL-NS-04(a) is written for, and it is also the statement that fixes the sub-location for the purpose of attributing any mislocation.

The driver never closed the last stretch to the point the rider had named. His own telemetry puts his closest approach to the pin at 33.72 m across the entire trace and his mean distance at 296.72 m, while the rider sat 6.49 m from that same pin - the two devices never came near each other, and 'I was practically at the pin' is a statement the driver's own device contradicts. He answered 'you walk' at 17:36:20 and again at 17:37:10, and cancelled at 17:40:50 without moving. Whether or not the geofence reading puts him technically inside the 50 m radius, the policy's only fault-allocation rule for a failed pickup, POL-NS-03, looks to the chat log and puts the loss on the driver where the rider has stated the correct entrance or sub-location and the driver does not move to it. On this record the driver bears that loss and should take no compensation out of the rider's fee under POL-NS-07.

The driver cannot stretch his hold with any advisory allowance. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00621-01, is MISSING - weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, 'no advisory covers the pickup road in this window' - and POL-NS-06(i) requires an advisory that is present and populated, so that limb is unavailable to him. There is in any event a single in-geofence interval on this trace (run_count 1, longest_run_sec 350.0), so there is no second interval to accumulate and the driver's hold must stand or fall on the one run the trace reports.

The rider does not get POL-NS-04's automatic exoneration and does not pretend otherwise: limb (b) requires that the driver did not reply in the chat within 120 seconds of the rider's message, and the log shows the driver replied at 17:36:20, only 40 seconds after the rider's 17:35:40 message, with a second reply at 17:37:10. Limb (b) therefore fails on the clause's own terms and the clause does not apply to this trip. The rider's case rests on the arrival facts and on the fault allocation in POL-NS-03, not on POL-NS-04.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs. (a) EV-TRIP-00621 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-21T17:34:52+08:00; (b) EV-GPS-00621 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence from 17:34:50, two seconds BEFORE that event, so limb (b)'s 'at or before' condition is met; (c) the same trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 350 seconds from 17:34:50 to 17:40:40 against the 300-second STANDARD minimum; and (d) EV-TRIP-00621 records no boarding event and a driver termination at 17:40:50 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed. All four conditions hold and no clause displaces them, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable as itemised.

The POL-NS-02 arrival geofence test is met on admissible fixes: EV-GPS-00621 contains 36 consecutive position fixes inside the arrival radius for STANDARD, comfortably above the three-fix minimum, and the driver's closest approach to the pin is 33.72 m — inside the 50 m radius, not outside it. No rider-side argument that the driver 'never arrived' can run against this trace.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06. The minimum dwell for STANDARD is 300 seconds, the measured continuous in-geofence dwell is 350 seconds, and the computed shortfall against the longest-run basis is minus 50 seconds — a surplus of 50, not a deficit. Nothing in POL-NS-06 supports refunding any part of the fee on this record.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the 'arrived' marker at 17:34:52 sits inside the geofence, not more than 300 m from the pin, so it is not a false marker. Even if the rider were to attack the marker, limb (iii) is dispositive — the corrected dwell, recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 17:34:50, is 350 seconds and meets the 300-second minimum, so a marker dispute cannot defeat the fee.

The rider-exonerating clause POL-NS-04 does not apply because limb (b) fails on the chat record: the rider's coordinating message at 17:35:40 was answered by the driver at 17:36:20 — 40 seconds later, well inside the 120-second window — and the driver answered the rider's 17:36:40 message at 17:37:10, 30 seconds later. A driver who does reply within 120 seconds takes the case out of POL-NS-04 regardless of the reply's content.

POL-NS-03, the wrong-entrance clause, is not available on these facts: it fires only where the driver held position for the dwell OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius while remaining within 400 m of the pin. Here the 350-second dwell was inside the 50 m radius, so the clause's own precondition fails. trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, which also removes limb (ii), so no platform-funded pin-ambiguity goodwill arises either.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 3.20 — with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, far below 0.08. Both limbs must trip and neither does, so compensation is payable.

The charged fee reconciles with the fee schedule, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect: the STANDARD zone-class fee is SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00; the resolution_rule takes the greater, SGD 4.00, which is exactly the fare_breakdown cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00 and the amount actually charged. There is no arithmetic irregularity for the rider to exploit.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and so is nowhere near the '3 or more' threshold; and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the two-or-more repeat-dispute trigger is not met. Escalation would place this fee on hold, and nothing on this record warrants halting a fee the policy makes chargeable. The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not the trailing-window field POL-NS-09(d) reads.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you were at the pickup. The rider's phone shows 42 fixes, a mean of 6.49 m and a maximum of 11.74 m from the pin at Blk 41 Sims Dr (shelter pickup), so she was genuinely waiting. The driver's trace shows him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from 17:34:50 and stationary there for a continuous 350 seconds. The fee is decided on the driver's side of that test, and it stands.

POL-NS-01 — all four limbs hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 17:34:52. (b) The GPS trace places him inside the 50 m pickup radius at 17:34:50, two seconds before that event. (c) The trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 350 seconds, 17:34:50 to 17:40:40, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the tap. (d) The trip record shows no boarding and a driver cancellation at 17:40:50 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 30 seconds after the dwell elapsed.

The rider's points, answered. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance): I reject the argument that the driver should bear the loss. POL-NS-03 applies only where the driver is stationary OUTSIDE the 50 m arrival radius but within 400 m. His dwell was inside the radius — his closest approach to the pin was 33.72 m — so the clause's own precondition fails, and with it both the fault allocation and any pin-ambiguity goodwill (trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1 in any case). That the rider correctly named the shelter in chat at 17:35:40 therefore changes nothing. POL-NS-04: the rider does not get automatic exoneration, because the driver replied at 17:36:20, 40 seconds after the rider's 17:35:40 message and inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) fails on the clause's own terms. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker): not engaged — the marker sits inside the geofence, not more than 300 m from the pin, and the recomputed dwell meets the minimum regardless. POL-NS-06 (short dwell): no shortfall — 350 seconds against a 300-second minimum is a surplus of 50 seconds. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00621-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is immaterial: it can carry no fact, and with a single unbroken in-geofence run there are no separate intervals to sum.

POL-NS-08: the charged fee reconciles. The greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 4.00, exactly the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line and the SGD 4.00 charged, so there is no integrity defect.

POL-NS-07 and the outcome. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, which is SGD 3.20, the residual SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 / 120 completed trips is 0.008 (below 0.08), so both limbs are unmet and compensation is payable. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present. The driver's brief mentions the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used; the trailing-window rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the counterparty-dispute counters are both 0. Under POL-GEN-03 this is a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling: amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.20 figure as driver_compensation_sgd, and the rider's SGD 4.00 charge stands as recorded (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The rider's claim is not supported on this record and the disputed fee is not refunded.

Confidence 0.90: every artifact that carries a deciding fact — the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown — is at full weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
